title: Refill Cadence Schedule for the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program
content:
The fulfilment centres ship Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program refills on the cadence each tier fixes: how many days of supply one standard refill shipment carries, how early a refill may ship, when Larkfield's refill reminder may be made, and whether each refill needs the customer's own confirmation.

| Tier | Standard days of supply per refill shipment | Refill ship lead days (before the previous refill's supply ends) | Refill reminder lead time (days before the planned ship date) | Per-shipment refill confirmation required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 30 | 7 | 7 | No (subscription shipping on schedule) |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 30 | 7 | 10 | Yes |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 90 | 10 | 10 | Yes |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 90 | 10 | 14 | Yes |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 90 | 10 | 14 | Yes |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 30 | 7 | 14 | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Standard days of supply per refill shipment**: the standard days of supply in one refill shipment, in calendar days, always a multiple of 30.
- **Refill ship lead days**: the earliest point a refill may ship, in calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of the same item.
- **Refill reminder lead time**: the earliest point for Larkfield's refill-reminder contact, in calendar days before the planned ship date.
- **Per-shipment refill confirmation**: whether each refill requires the customer's own confirmation of continued use and quantity on hand before it ships; where it is not required, refills ship on the subscription schedule.

## Comparing tiers

- Three tiers ship 90-day supplies (the CGM Commercial PPO Program, the CGM Medicare Advantage Program and the CGM Original Medicare Program), each with 10 refill ship lead days; the other three ship 30-day supplies with 7 lead days.
- The CGM Self-Pay Program is the only tier without a per-shipment confirmation.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

On a hypothetical tier with a 60-day standard supply and 5 refill ship lead days, a previous refill shipped on 1 March has a supply that ends 60 calendar days later, on 30 April; the earliest permitted ship date of the next refill is 5 calendar days before that end date, 25 April.
